evidence.title: amux README (v0.0.21)
evidence.locator: Prerequisites; How it works; Features; Controls; Configuration; Platform Support; Operations
evidence.finding: TUI that runs parallel coding agents in tmux sessions over git-worktree workspaces; commit and merge actions, lifecycle scripts, port reservations, minisign-verified self-update; MIT; Linux and macOS only.

evidence.title: MIT license
evidence.finding: MIT License text.

evidence.title: go.mod
evidence.finding: Go 1.26 module github.com/andyrewlee/amux using Bubble Tea v2.

evidence.title: Entry point
evidence.finding: Binary accepts only --version; builds exclude Windows; launches the TUI on a real TTY.

evidence.title: External orchestration contract
evidence.locator: Status of this contract; Session naming grammar; @amux_* tags
evidence.finding: amux has no CLI or API; the supported external control surface is the tmux layer with documented session names and @amux_* tags.

evidence.title: Configuration reference
evidence.locator: assistants map; ui section; environment variables; self-update
evidence.finding: ~/.amux/config.json lets users override or add assistants by launch command and interrupt behavior.

evidence.title: Storage policies
evidence.finding: Local JSON stores under ~/.amux with atomic writes, backups and fail-closed port reservations.

evidence.title: Agent registry
evidence.finding: Fourteen built-in launch commands: claude, codex, opencode, droid, cursor (agent), pi, omp, antigravity (agy), fx, grok, amp, cline, devin, prime-agent.

evidence.title: UI settings
evidence.finding: notify_on_done rings a terminal bell when an agent finishes; default off.

evidence.title: Activity detection
evidence.finding: Detects agent activity from tmux output to drive done badges and the on-done hook.

evidence.title: Lifecycle scripts
evidence.finding: Runs repo/workspace/project scripts with per-workspace ports, trust gating and bounded transcripts.

evidence.title: Self-update
evidence.finding: Only outbound call found: GitHub releases/latest check at startup; downloads are minisign-verified.

evidence.title: Architecture
evidence.finding: Go packages for app, tmux, pty, vterm, data, process and UI.

evidence.title: Contributing
evidence.finding: No GitHub Actions; checks run locally via make ci with a tmux version matrix.

evidence.title: amux docs introduction
evidence.finding: Pure TUI with no wrappers; cloud sandbox workspaces described as coming soon; tmux required.

evidence.title: Workspaces
evidence.finding: Workspaces are git worktrees on their own branch; delete removes directory and branch.

evidence.title: GitHub repository metadata
evidence.finding: 168 stars, MIT, no homepage, pushed 2026-11-12, not archived; companion repos amux-docs and homebrew-amux.

evidence.title: GitHub releases
evidence.finding: Latest v0.0.21 published 2026-11-03; 21 releases; previous v0.0.20 on 2026-07-17.

evidence.title: amux in action screenshot
evidence.finding: Real amux TUI with projects and workspaces, agent tabs and a Changes sidebar.

evidence.title: Bounded search: pull requests
evidence.locator: rg -i "gh pr|pull request|create_pull" over internal/, cmd/, scripts/ (non-test)
evidence.finding: No PR creation or GitHub API code; hits are contributor docs and a Makefile target only. README says amux never pushes.

evidence.title: Bounded search: MCP
evidence.finding: No MCP client or server code.

evidence.title: Bounded search: schedules and webhooks
evidence.finding: No scheduler or webhook code; hits are terminal rendering and flush scheduling. Only the on-done hook reacts to agent state.

evidence.title: Bounded search: accounts, roles, SSO, sync
evidence.finding: No user accounts, roles, sharing or SSO.

evidence.title: Bounded search: hosted or sandbox execution
evidence.finding: No hosted service, container or VM execution; only local tmux and git worktrees; Docker appears only in CI tmux-matrix scripts.

evidence.title: Bounded search: cost, tokens, spend, telemetry
evidence.locator: rg -i "telemetry|analytics|posthog|sentry|token usage|spend limit|budget" over internal/, cmd/
evidence.finding: No telemetry, usage accounting or spend limits in amux.

evidence.title: Bounded search: issues and tasks
evidence.finding: No issue or task tracker; workspaces are the only work unit.

evidence.title: Bounded search: other clients
evidence.locator: rg -i "electron|tauri|android|ios app|web ui|http server" over internal/, cmd/; cmd/amux/main.go
evidence.finding: No desktop, mobile or web client; only pprof on loopback when enabled.
